en.title: U
en.summary: The letter U is the twenty-second letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter name and sound
paragraphs: The name of this letter sounds like /u/. Its main sound is heard in the word (urs) /ˈu.nuls/, which means one. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: Mouth shape and air
paragraphs: Pull your tongue back and raise it high. Round your lips into a tight circle and vibrate your vocal cords. For the gliding sound, keep the same shape and glide quickly into another vowel. Touch your throat to feel the steady vibration.

sections.title: Reading the variants
paragraphs: As a normal vowel, this letter makes the sound /u/, as in (unu) /ˈu.nu/. When this letter stands next to another vowel, it makes the gliding sound /w/, as in (nou) /now/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make this sound long like the vowel in moon. Keep the sound short and firm. Do not add an extra sound like in the English word you.
